kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتضب (form VIII)
# نَقْتَضِبُ (naqtaḍibu) /naq.ta.dˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# نُقْتَضَبُ (nuqtaḍabu) /nuq.ta.dˤa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# نَقْتَضِبَ (naqtaḍiba) /naq.ta.dˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# نُقْتَضَبَ (nuqtaḍaba) /nuq.ta.dˤa.b
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
